message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "libyara/parser.c", "function": "yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration", "line": 544, "var": "str->c_string", "code": "result = yr_re_parse(str->c_string, &re_ast, &re_error);", "note": "Attacker-controlled YARA rule string is parsed into a regexp AST (re_ast) with root_node of type RE_NODE_CONCAT containing children [RANGE_ANY(.{201,300}?), LITERAL(x)]"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "libyara/parser.c", "function": "yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration", "line": 604, "var": "re_ast", "code": "result = yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point(re_ast, &re_ast, &remainder_re_ast, &min_gap, &max_gap);", "note": "First split: the non-greedy RANGE_ANY child (start=201, end=300) is the first child of CONCAT; the function sets concat->children_head = re_ast->root_node->children_head (pointing to the RANGE_ANY node), then destroys that node with yr_re_node_destroy(child), leaving concat->children_head as a dangling pointer"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "libyara/re.c", "function": "yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point", "line": 514, "var": "child", "code": "yr_re_node_destroy(child);", "note": "The RANGE_ANY node is freed; concat->children_head still points to it. The concat node becomes remainder_re_ast->root_node"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "libyara/parser.c", "function": "yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration", "line": 639, "var": "re_ast", "code": "yr_re_ast_destroy(re_ast);", "note": "The original re_ast (tail part) is destroyed"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "libyara/parser.c", "function": "yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration", "line": 642, "var": "remainder_re_ast", "code": "result = yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point(remainder_re_ast, &re_ast, &remainder_re_ast, &min_gap, &max_gap);", "note": "Second split called on remainder_re_ast whose root_node is the concat node with dangling children_head"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "libyara/re.c", "function": "yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point", "line": 480, "var": "child->greedy", "code": "child = re_ast->root_node->children_head; while (child != NULL) { if (!child->greedy && ...)", "note": "READ of freed RANGE_ANY node via concat->children_head dangling pointer; child->greedy accesses freed memory at offset 12, causing heap-use-after-free"}
]
EOF
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
